blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Unlike the back-jobs in the Edsa rehabilitation project, which could be easily fixed by an asphalt overlay, the allegedly substandard road dike project in Oriental Mindoro—the subject of the graft case against former Ako Bicol Rep. Zaldy Co and other Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) officials—would require uprooting its steel sheet piles (SSPs). During his testimony before the Sandiganbayan Fifth Division, former DPWH Chief Vince Dizon was asked by Henecito Balasolia, counsel for former DPWH Region IV-B head of quality assurance and hydrology division Dennis Abagon, if the contractor Sunwest could rectify the project’s defects at […]...
